normalization_plan.malformed_or_bad_metadata: Fixed canonical phase view using known x/phase auxiliary data/empty deterministic-wrapper tape and p empty real-prover messages; this is syntactic checking only, not witness or transcript-consistency checking.
normalization_plan.well_parsed_output: Take at most p received real-prover messages, truncate each to B(n), pad missing entries with [], then append k-p honest-prover [] fillers.
normalization_plan.real_view_fixed_reason: Fixed k-step execution has exactly p prover sends, real metadata is known and hB bounds every honest prover output for all tapes/histories on R-witnessed instances.
normalization_plan.strict_bound: Every retained phase contributes exactly k messages, each at most B(n); encoded prefix length ≤ Q(n)*k*(2*B(n)+2). Original auxiliary input/tape/index/fixed pairing overhead add only polynomial cost.
normalization_plan.zero_cases: k=0 or Q(n)=0: sample verifier tape and output canonical empty-history view directly. B(n)=0 and zero coin lengths require no added positivity/nonemptiness premise.
normalization_plan.computational_comparison: Use same normalization and simulated suffix on both sides. Existing nonuniform D can hardwire maximizing phase/prefix and polynomially bounded x,z,r as advice, without an efficient honest prover or witness.
normalization_plan.statistical_comparison: For fixed prefix, total normalization fixes real distribution and cannot increase StatClose; average over prefixes and sum Q gaps. Error remains Q*δ, including δ=0.
